# Lint Forge

> Desktop rule review app for Biome, ESLint and Ruff configurations.

Lint Forge helps developers select a linter, import existing settings, review unconfigured rules in a deck, and generate a custom config. Progress is stored separately for each tool in the browser.

## Links

- [Live app](https://lint-forge.marlonpassos.com.br/)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/MarlonPassos-git/lint-forge)
- [Biome documentation](https://biomejs.dev/)
- [Biome review](https://lint-forge.marlonpassos.com.br/biome)
- [ESLint review](https://lint-forge.marlonpassos.com.br/eslint)
- [Ruff review](https://lint-forge.marlonpassos.com.br/ruff)
